@lambada-llc/codemirror-lang-lambada

Stock CodeMirror plus lambada(), the package's one extension — the grammar so far. Nothing compiles anything.

ⓘ Not part of this package: CodeMirror's default highlight style leaves several of the grammar's tags unpainted — operators, brackets and lambda binders among them — and a theme is how a host fills them in. Switch it off to see the difference.
